## InfoMenuExtensionsBuilder.register property

Registers a new info menu item.

**Signature:**

```typescript
register: (item: InfoMenuExtension) => this;
```

## Remarks

This method only registers the info menu item and does not automatically make it visible in the application. To add the info menu item to the application, use [InfoMenuExtensionsBuilder.config](./extensions.infomenuextensionsbuilder.config.md)<!-- -->.
